# Security policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes ship on the current release line, or on the default branch for a repository without versioned releases. Older releases receive no fixes.

## Reporting

Open an issue that only asks for a preferred security contact. Keep exploit details, reproduction steps for an unfixed weakness, credentials, and private host information out of that issue; provide them through the contact the maintainer names in reply.

A report names the affected version, the affected component, the observed behavior, and the steps that reproduce it.

## Scope

The trust boundaries, request guards, credentials, and data exposed by this repository belong to its own reporting channel. Weaknesses in another project's code belong to that project's reporting channel.

## Handling

Maintainers answer the contact request and assess each finding against the current release line. Report details stay out of public issues until a fix is published.
